notes.title: Multiplayer Server is Back Online!
notes.content: I decided to bring the servers back online during the Spring Sale! The servers will be online at least through the upcoming War Games Fest! Have fun!

notes.title: Multiplayer Servers Have Been Shut Down
notes.content:
Due to lack of players, I have shut down the multiplayer servers.

If there is demand in the future, perhaps I will fire the server back up. But until then, it does not make financial sense to continue paying to operate the server if no one is playing.

- Todd

notes.content:

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content: This small patch fixes the issue where the chart on the game over screen would not show the lines correctly.

notes.title: 1.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Today is a huge day! Over the past few years, we have spent most of our spare time, that was not consumed by family and other life events, working on this game.

We are proud to release 1.0 and hope you enjoy it with us! Perhaps, we'll meet in an online match sometime soon.

Without further ado. It's time to launch!

Huzzah!

Todd & Chadrick @ Legacy Gameworks

notes.title: Next Fest & New UI!
notes.content:
[b]Next Fest starts June 10th![/b]

Please share the demo with your friends and family, and even total strangers. Use this opportunity to sign up for the play test where you can also try out multiplayer!  

[b]New Context Aware UI[/b]

We've updated the UI to improve the game play experience and make it much more intuitive. The context aware UI shows above the selected unit, and under the tile selected where necessary. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41721642/69c350496a6ad79b7d1472428b3f6881fc132b13.png[/img]

It also shows hint icons above tiles where new villages or mage towers can be constructed. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41721642/55efd20bf7f1c79ac5dcdb336bf340a5f1adc259.png[/img]

Have a great day!

Todd

notes.title: Name Change, Demo Update & Upcoming Play Test
notes.content:
[b]What's In a Name?[/b]

As you may have seen on the Store page, the game has a new name. Fealty! 

The name change is for a few reasons, but mainly we didn't think the old name reflected what the game is. We did not want to assume a storyline for the game and the old name seemed to suggest that there was one. It's a strategy game, pure and simple, and we think the new name reflects that better.

We have updated the demo to include the name change and other fixes/changes. 

[b]Multiplayer Play Test[/b]

We will be announcing the multiplayer play test here on Steam soon. So please be on the lookout for that. The game has a decent AI that is fun to play against in solo play, but there is something special about playing with and against others that we can't wait for you to experience.

Have a great day!

Todd

notes.title: Demo Update 0.91.1
notes.content:
We just released a small update to the demo that addresses a few minor issues with the demo.

Mainly, the primary fix was that the arrow would not point at the proper UI element unless you were running the game in a 16:9 aspect ratio.  This has been corrected so it should point properly in any aspect ratio now.

We also addressed a graphical issue that made the whole game look grainy in some cases.

Beyond that, there were just a few minor changes to some text to make the tutorial a bit better.

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41721642/939fd73f8637e969e0e48836b72c60e804fe7c2d.png[/img]

[b]The Demo is now live! [/b]

We hope you enjoy playing it. We are looking forward to hearing your feedback as we work on finishing up the rest of the game.  The demo allows single player mode only on a single map seed and 35 turns of play.  Each play through of the demo will be different due to starting locations being randomized as well. 

We will be announcing a new release date soon so stay tuned for that! 

In the meantime, have fun!
